newsitem.title: USA: Foundation Health April oper shr $0.16.
newsitem.headline: Foundation Health April oper shr $0.16.

text.p: Foundation Health Systems Inc on Tuesday reported net income for April of $19.5 million, or $0.16 per share before merger-related expenses.
In a statement, the managed health care company said its April 1 merger with Heath Systems International Inc caused it to report earnings for the month.

The company generated revenues of $637.3 million in April. It's expenses, including merger costs, were $649.2 million resuulting in an $11.9 million pre-tax loss. The company's April net loss was $7.6 million, or $.06 per share.
Foundation Health said it expects to report "substantial additional" merger costs in its second quarter results.

Foundation Health is nation's fourth-largest publicly traded managed health care company. The company's HMO, insured PPO and government contracts units provide health benefits to nearly five million people in 17 states.
